premise: The forest band cannot play together until Woodpecker taps a beat on the old tree that everyone can follow.
inspiration: The Bremen Town Musicians (Grimm), turned: the band never leaves home, and what it was missing was not a stage but a shared rhythm.
lesson: Listening to each other is what makes music together.
learning: Woodpeckers drum on trees to talk to each other

en-US.title: Woodpecker Keeps the Beat
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.3} The forest band wanted to play a song. [excited] One, two, three, GO! {frog:enter} Frog hopped into the pond and {frog:hop} sang, ribbit! {bee:enter} Bee came buzzing through the air. She {bee:live} took a deep breath, hummed with her eyes closed, and wiggled a little dance. {bird:enter} Bird flew down to a branch and {bird:pulse} whistled, tweet! {all:wobble} But everyone went at a different speed. Ribbit-bzzz-tweet-ribbit-tweet! {frog:face surprised} {bee:face surprised} [giggles] What a muddle. Then {woodpecker:enter} Woodpecker flew to the trunk of the big tree. [curious] Listen, he said. {woodpecker:live} {sfx:tap-tap} Tap, tap, tap! He pressed his eye to the bark and listened… then tapped once more, and chirped. Far away, another woodpecker drummed back. {sfx:far-drum solo} {woodpecker:face happy} [whispers] That's my cousin saying hello, said Woodpecker. Now, follow my taps. Tap, ribbit. Tap, bzzz. Tap, tweet. {all:face happy} [happily] And Bird {bird:live} puffed up his chest and sang his longest, happiest song, while the whole band played {frog:hearts} {bee:hearts} together, all afternoon long.

es-ES.title: El pájaro carpintero marca el ritmo
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.3} La banda del bosque quería tocar una canción. [excited] ¡Un, dos, tres, YA! {frog:enter} Rana saltó a la charca y {frog:hop} cantó: ¡croac! {bee:enter} Abeja llegó zumbando por el aire. {bee:live} Respiró hondo, zumbó con los ojos cerrados y se marcó un bailecito. {bird:enter} Pájaro bajó volando a una rama y {bird:pulse} silbó: ¡pío! {all:wobble} Pero cada uno iba a su velocidad. ¡Croac-bzzz-pío-croac-pío! {frog:face surprised} {bee:face surprised} [giggles] Menudo lío. Entonces el {woodpecker:enter} pájaro carpintero voló hasta el tronco del árbol grande. [curious] Escuchad, dijo. {woodpecker:live} {sfx:tap-tap} ¡Toc, toc, toc! Pegó el ojo a la corteza y escuchó… luego dio otro toque, y pió. A lo lejos, otro pájaro carpintero le contestó con su tamborileo. {sfx:far-drum solo} {woodpecker:face happy} [whispers] Es mi primo, que me saluda, dijo el carpintero. Ahora, seguid mis toques. Toc, croac. Toc, bzzz. Toc, pío. {all:face happy} [happily] Y Pájaro {bird:live} hinchó el pecho y cantó su canción más larga y más alegre, mientras toda la banda tocaba {frog:hearts} {bee:hearts} junta, toda la tarde.

tap-tap.prompt: a woodpecker tapping three quick light knocks on a hollow tree trunk

far-drum.prompt: a distant woodpecker drumming a quick soft rat-a-tat on a far-away tree
